LCN 1261RWPA Parallel Arm Adjustable 1-5 Surface Mounted Regular Door Closer with Thru Bolts

The LCN 1261RWPA is a light to medium duty cast iron closer designed to fit the most common commercial footprint. It's adjustable for spring sizes 1-5.

Features and Specifications of The LCN 1261RWPAAL Door Closer:

  • Grade 1 - ANSI A156.4
  • Cast Iron Housing
  • All weather fluid.
  • Adjustable spring size 1-5
  • Parallel Arm
  • Non Handed

Sold Individually
